anchor_desc: Guard rejecting a request when recent hits have reached the configured limit.

cases.name: unrelated_line_changed
cases.note: Changing the MAX_RETRIES constant leaves the anchored line byte-identical at the same position.

cases.name: lines_inserted_above
cases.note: Inserting a const and a key guard above shifts the anchored line down by four with identical text.

cases.name: whitespace_change
cases.note: Only the leading indentation of the anchored line changes; tokens are unchanged.

cases.name: trailing_punct_added
cases.note: Drops the optional semicolon on the line above (ASI) while the anchored line stays identical at the same position.

cases.name: variable_renamed
cases.note: Renames the local recent to timestamps everywhere, including on the anchored comparison.

cases.name: rename_and_ops_changed
cases.note: Renames recent to timestamps and changes the comparison from >= to > on the same line (Type-3 near-miss).

cases.name: anchor_line_deleted
cases.note: The limit guard and its early return are removed entirely, so the anchor has no real target.

cases.name: boilerplate_trap
cases.note: The anchored guard is deleted while several similar `if (opts.length >= this.X) {` lines are introduced as decoys.
